scope: One new two-role numeric metadata case and two new synthetic real-process ownership cases on Ubuntu24.04 ARM64. No communication, provider, browser or complete media workload is executed by these checks. Native fixture integration and full workload observations remain pending.
behaviors: Existing process sampler accepts exactly declared server/helper roles for native collection, retaining its default three-role behavior for existing callers.

One-second sampled RSS, observed lifetime CPU, thread and open-descriptor counts are attributed separately to server and helper trees; no process names, commands, file targets, credentials or media enter reports.
Missing descriptor metadata remains null/unavailable while an otherwise current process remains live. PID start-time mismatch cannot adopt a reused process or its descendants.
The command supervisor stays unreaped through all original group decisions. A successful early controller exit with an unsampled live worker fails collection and retires its original group.
Resource collection failure cannot discard completed independent decode results. Parent cancellation preserves original cleanup and rethrows.
limits: Observed lifetime CPU includes prior server setup; this is not media-window-only CPU. RSS may double-count shared pages; samples may miss short-lived descendants. Collection does not prove idle-resource restoration or qualify a transport cell. macOS and Remote-profile native collection are explicitly unrun.
